globalFlags.name: yes
globalFlags.description: 确认策略允许由参数确认的操作

subcommands.name: director
subcommands.summary: 导演台创作、同步与导出

subcommands.name: create
subcommands.summary: 在画布上创建导演台节点

flags.name: file
flags.description: 另存已绑定画布节点的新工作副本
flags.constraints: Optional new path; the stage is always created on the canvas first and this file is a bound work copy whose later edits need push

flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 画布项目 UUID；默认当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID; defaults to current project; a bound work file retains its project

subcommands.name: pull
subcommands.summary: 读取画布导演台到新文件

flags.name: file
flags.constraints: Local work file; required for pull/push/freeze; exclusive with node-id except pull

flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 画布项目 UUID；默认当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID; defaults to current project; a bound work file retains its project

flags.name: version-id
flags.description: 正文版本；默认当前版本
flags.constraints: uint64 decimal; omitted means current version

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.summary: 查看并校验画布或本地场景

flags.name: file
flags.constraints: Local work file; required for pull/push/freeze; exclusive with node-id except pull

flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 画布项目 UUID；默认当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID; defaults to current project; a bound work file retains its project

flags.name: node-id
flags.description: 直接操作画布导演台；与 file 互斥
flags.constraints: required without file; reads latest canvas version

subcommands.name: apply
subcommands.summary: 原子应用场景、镜头、姿势、动画或分镜命令

flags.name: file
flags.constraints: Local work file; required for pull/push/freeze; exclusive with node-id except pull

flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 画布项目 UUID；默认当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID; defaults to current project; a bound work file retains its project

flags.name: node-id
flags.description: 直接操作画布导演台；与 file 互斥
flags.constraints: required without file; reads latest canvas version

flags.name: input
flags.description: 有序类型化命令数组 JSON 文件
flags.constraints: JSON array of 1..256 typed commands; all-or-nothing; per-command fields in catalog --kind builtin commandFields

subcommands.name: push
subcommands.summary: 保存正文并原子更新画布版本

flags.name: file
flags.constraints: Local work file; required for pull/push/freeze; exclusive with node-id except pull

flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 画布项目 UUID；默认当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID; defaults to current project; a bound work file retains its project

flags.name: force
flags.description: 画布已有他人保存的较新版本时仍用本文件覆盖；仅在用户明确要求时使用
flags.constraints: replace a newer canvas version; only after cli.director_version_conflict and explicit user consent

subcommands.name: catalog
subcommands.summary: 发现内置几何体、预设、人物或动作

flags.name: kind
flags.constraints: builtin|character|motion

subcommands.name: export
subcommands.summary: 导出截图或视频（需本机浏览器）或 FBX 动作

flags.name: file
flags.constraints: Local work file; required for pull/push/freeze; exclusive with node-id except pull

flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 画布项目 UUID；默认当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID; defaults to current project; a bound work file retains its project

flags.name: node-id
flags.description: 直接操作画布导演台；与 file 互斥
flags.constraints: required without file; reads latest canvas version

flags.name: output
flags.constraints: new file; required for local export; optional for preview; forbidden with to-canvas

flags.name: workspace
flags.description: staging 或 performance；仅选择渲染工作区
flags.constraints: staging|performance; defaults to snapshot session

flags.name: camera-id
flags.description: 镜头 ID；默认输出镜头
flags.constraints: cannot combine with storyboard

flags.name: frame
flags.constraints: >=0; image only

flags.name: type
flags.constraints: image|video|fbx

flags.name: motion-id
flags.description: 导出 FBX 的动作 ID
flags.constraints: required for fbx

flags.name: to-canvas
flags.description: 上传导出结果并创建真实画布媒体节点
flags.constraints: image/video only; requires media-upload capability and write environment
